kinepage.message: Amir and Kaya messing with radio. May affect your time. Sorry. A.

translations.fr: Amir et Kaya s'amusent avec la radio. Cela pourrait perturber le temps. Désolé. A.
translations.it: Amir e Kaya stanno giocando con la radio. Potrebbe influire sul tempo. Mi dispiace. A.
translations.de: Amir und Kaya spielen mit dem Radio rum. Das könnte deine Zeit beeinflussen. Entschuldigung. A.
translations.es: Amir y Kaya están jugando con la radio. Esto puede afectar tu tiempo. Una disculpa. A.
translations.pt: O Amir e a Kaya estão mexendo no rádio, isso pode afetar sua conexão. Foi mal.
translations.ru: Амир и Кайя вмешиваются в работу радио. Это может повлиять на ваше время. Извините. А.
translations.pl: Amir i Kaya majstrują przy radiu. To może wpłynąć na twój czas. Sorry. A.
translations.uk: Амір і Кая граються з радіо. Це може впливати на ваш час. Вибачайте. А.
translations.tr: Amir ve Kaya radyoyla uğraşıyor. Bu, zaman kavramını etkileyebilir. Özür dilerim. A.
translations.ja: AmirとKayaがラジオをハイジャックした。時空に歪みができるかもしれない。すまない。-Arthur
translations.zh: 阿米尔和卡娅在摆弄收音机。这可能会影响到你的时间。抱歉。——亚瑟留。
translations.ko: 아미르와 카야가 라디오로 장난질을 치고 있군. 네 시간에도 영향이 갈 지도 모른다. 미안하다. A.
translations.tc: 阿米爾和卡婭在亂搞無線電，可能會干擾到你的時間。抱歉了。－亞瑟。
translations.th: Amir กับ Kaya กำลังปรับแต่งสัญญาณวิทยุอยู่ ซึ่งอาจส่งผลกระทบต่อเวลา ต้องขออภัยด้วย จาก A.

deviation.name: Hazardous Goods
deviation.description: Amphors deal elemental damage while carried.

risks.name: Vampyric Liminus
risks.description: Slow moving, immortal, Duviri Liminus drain health and energy from allies who get too close.

deviation.name: Parasitic Towers
deviation.description: Life Support Towers only activate after 20 enemies have been killed within a 15m radius of them.

risks.name: Devil's Bargain
risks.description: Allies within 4m of slain enemies gain 25% Fire Rate at the cost of -50% Ammo Efficiency.

risks.name: Entanglement
risks.description: Allies within 4m of slain enemies endure reduced Movement Speed and Parkour Velocity.

deviation.name: Glyph Inflation
deviation.description: The security system requires twice as many Vosphene Glyphs to activate.

risks.name: Fortified Foes
risks.description: Guardian Eximus units may be encountered, including Guardian Eximus Necramechs.

personalModifiers.name: Knifestep Syndrome
personalModifiers.description: Lose 2 Health when moving. Jumping pauses the effect.

personalModifiers.name: Untreatable
personalModifiers.description: Pickups do not heal, and Health Orbs cannot be picked up.

personalModifiers.name: Energy Exhaustion
personalModifiers.description: Lose 2 Energy per second for each enemy within 10 meters of you.

deviation.name: Cache Crash
deviation.description: Consequences of opening a Supply Cache are active from the start and will intensify if the Supply Cache is opened. Failure to open a Supply Cache doubles the kill count required to finish the mission.

risks.name: It's Alive
risks.description: Within the underground, hostile overgrowths will attack if players stops moving.

risks.name: Devil's Bargain
risks.description: Allies within 4m of slain enemies gain 25% Fire Rate at the cost of -50% Ammo Efficiency.

deviation.name: Mitosis
deviation.description: Two Legacytes spawn each round and twice as many captures are needed for success.

risks.name: Heavy Warfare
risks.description: Enemies take 95% less damage from non-heavy weapons. Enemies will drop heavy ammo packs and heavy weapon recall time reduced to 5s.

risks.name: Artillery Beacons
risks.description: When killed, Scaldra troops drop artillery beacons that summon bombardments.

deviation.name: Vampire Rock
deviation.description: Flare creates a field that disrupts player abilities while draining energy to boost Flare's health. Flare slowly loses health when no players are in range.

risks.name: Balloonfest
risks.description: Scaldra Harbingers are more numerous and attack and move more quickly.

risks.name: Competitive Streak
risks.description: Random negative penalties from Amir and Aoi's "Faceoff" mode will be applied throughout the mission.

personalModifiers.name: Knifestep Syndrome
personalModifiers.description: Lose 2 Health when moving. Jumping pauses the effect.

personalModifiers.name: Transference Distortion
personalModifiers.description: Transference into Operator and Drifter is blocked.

upgrade.title: Practiced Precision
upgrade.description: +20% Melee Critical Chance (x2 for Heavy Attacks).

upgrade.title: Punchcard
upgrade.description: Add +1.5m punch through to primary weapons.

upgrade.title: Force Of Attraction
upgrade.description: Magnetic Status Effects also pull in enemies within 1m per stack.

upgrade.title: Combo Killer
upgrade.description: Combo Multiplier increases the chance of enemies being susceptible to finishers after a melee hit. 5% per Multiplier Max 65% with Venka Prime.

upgrade.title: More the Merrier
upgrade.description: Non-Tenno Allies within 20m all gain +5% Melee Attack Speed and +20% Fire Rate for each one in range.

upgrade.title: Practiced Precision
upgrade.description: +20% Melee Critical Chance (x2 for Heavy Attacks).
